values.situation: Choose between a limited reporting pilot and an immediate rollout.
values.facts: Two customers requested reports. Delivery effort and willingness to pay are unknown.
values.options: Pilot with two customers, or rollout to all 30.
values.unknowns: What delivery effort would be sustainable?

suggestions.facts: Two customers requested reports. Delivery effort and willingness to pay are unknown.
suggestions.unknowns: What are the specific reporting needs of the two customers? What resources are available for delivery?

questions: What are the potential risks of an immediate rollout?
How critical are the reports to the two customers?
What feedback mechanisms will be in place for the pilot?
output.note: Understanding the delivery effort required and customer needs is crucial for making an informed choice.

context.label: Direction
context.value: Run a limited pilot with two customers before deciding on a rollout.

context.label: Unknowns
context.value: Delivery effort and willingness to pay have not been measured.

suggestions.direction: Run a limited pilot with two customers before deciding on a rollout.

questions: What specific metrics will you use to measure delivery effort?
How will you assess the willingness to pay from the two customers?
What timeframe do you have in mind for the pilot?
output.note: Clarifying the metrics for success and the timeframe for the pilot will help define the outcome and scope more effectively.

values.actions: Run a reporting pilot with two willing customers. No owners or dates agreed yet.
values.boundaries: Do not displace existing contracted work.

suggestions.actions: Identify two customers willing to participate in the reporting pilot and confirm their commitment.
suggestions.boundaries: Ensure that the pilot does not interfere with any ongoing contractual obligations.
suggestions.check: Establish criteria for evaluating the success of the pilot.
suggestions.review: Schedule a review meeting after the pilot to assess outcomes and gather feedback.

questions: Who will be responsible for reaching out to the customers?
What specific outcomes are expected from the pilot?
When do you plan to conduct the review meeting?
output.note: Clarifying roles and expected outcomes will help in structuring the pilot effectively.

values.observations: Two reports were delivered. One customer replied positively. The other has not replied. Delivery time was not recorded.

suggestions.observations: Two reports were delivered. One customer replied positively. The other has not replied. Delivery time was not recorded.
suggestions.nexttest: Consider sending a follow-up message to the customer who has not replied. Record the delivery time for future reference.

questions: What was the content of the reports?
What is the expected response time from customers?
Have there been any previous interactions with these customers?
output.note: The lack of recorded delivery time may hinder understanding of response patterns.
